title.en: The Royal Family, other monarchies and the legislatures
title.fr: La famille royale, d'autres monarchies et les assemblées législatives

text.en: The Royal Family serves the community for a lifetime. That example is meant to encourage citizens to give their own country their best.
text.fr: La famille royale sert la collectivité toute sa vie. Cet exemple vise à encourager les citoyens à donner le meilleur d'eux-mêmes à leur pays.

source.quote: The Royal Family’s example of lifelong service to the community is an encouragement for citizens to give their best to their country.

text.en: Other countries are constitutional monarchies too. They include Japan, Jordan and Morocco, and also Spain, the Netherlands, Thailand, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Australia and New Zealand.
text.fr: D'autres pays sont eux aussi des monarchies constitutionnelles. On y trouve le Japon, la Jordanie et le Maroc, ainsi que l'Espagne, les Pays-Bas, la Thaïlande, le Danemark, la Norvège, la Suède, l'Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande.

source.quote: Other constitutional monarchies include Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Australia, New Zealand, The Netherlands, Spain, Thailand, Japan, Jordan and Morocco.

text.en: Every province and territory has a legislature whose members are elected. Those members pass the laws for that province or territory.
text.fr: Chaque province et chaque territoire a une assemblée législative dont les membres sont élus. Ces membres adoptent les lois de la province ou du territoire.

source.quote: Each provincial and territorial government has an elected legislature where provincial and territorial laws are passed.
